items.source: Set whether the repository method metadata should be exposed by the repository factory as a ThreadLocal for retrieval via the RepositoryMethodContext class. This is useful if an advised object needs to obtain repository information.
items.translation: 设置是否将仓库方法元数据作为 ThreadLocal 由仓库工厂暴露，以便通过RepositoryMethodContext类进行检索。如果某个被代理的对象需要获取仓库信息，此功能非常有用。
